plain_italian_summary: Questa mappa dati descrive quali dati potrebbero entrare, uscire o restare nei sistemi MachineSignal. E' una bozza senza dati reali: serve a capire rischi, retention, cancellazione, ruoli privacy e blocchi prima di qualunque uso commerciale.

data_flows.trigger: A human or company owner creates an account for a machine/API integration.
data_flows.machine_actor: CRM, workflow, agent or software connected by the owner
data_flows.purpose: Account access, API key ownership, terms acceptance and support.
data_flows.legal_basis_to_confirm: contract or pre-contractual steps; legal obligation for billing after paid live
data_flows.retention_draft: Account lifetime plus limited legal/accounting retention after closure, to be approved.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Deactivate account, revoke API keys, retain only legally required billing/security records.
data_flows.live_blocker: fiscal_admin_go_live_gate and privacy notice final approval

data_flows.trigger: A machine calls sandbox endpoints using synthetic domains or examples.
data_flows.machine_actor: Postman, CRM test workflow, AI agent, local evaluator
data_flows.purpose: Test scoring, validate schemas and prove machine-readable flow.
data_flows.legal_basis_to_confirm: not applicable for synthetic data; contractual basis if tied to beta account
data_flows.storage_location_logical: sandbox logs and local test reports
data_flows.retention_draft: Short technical retention for debugging, suggested 30 days, to be approved.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Delete sandbox logs on request or scheduled cleanup.
data_flows.live_blocker: none for synthetic sandbox; still no external outreach

data_flows.trigger: A customer machine submits a list of companies or domains for scoring.
data_flows.actor: Customer account owner through machine integration
data_flows.machine_actor: CRM, enrichment workflow, sales automation software
data_flows.purpose: Score commercial opportunity for website/API/service need.
data_flows.legal_basis_to_confirm: customer responsibility and DPA if MachineSignal acts as processor
data_flows.storage_location_logical: scoring queue, temporary processing store, output store if enabled
data_flows.retention_draft: Input list deleted after processing or within a short period, suggested 7-30 days, to be approved.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Delete raw input, retain aggregated score metadata only if allowed.
data_flows.live_blocker: privacy_data_map approval, DPA, retention approval, terms acceptance flow

data_flows.trigger: A customer machine asks MachineSignal to find companies/domains in a niche and area.
data_flows.actor: Customer account owner through machine integration
data_flows.machine_actor: AI procurement agent, CRM workflow, data ops agent
data_flows.purpose: Prepare business-domain targets for machine scoring, not human outreach.
data_flows.legal_basis_to_confirm: controller/processor role and public-source policy to be defined
data_flows.storage_location_logical: target discovery work queue and output pack store
data_flows.retention_draft: Output retained only for customer retrieval window, suggested 30-90 days, to be approved.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Delete output packs after expiry or customer request.
data_flows.live_blocker: source policy, no-contact-data rule, legal review, owner approval

data_flows.trigger: MachineSignal returns score, decision and optional action pack.
data_flows.machine_actor: Receiving CRM, workflow or AI agent
data_flows.purpose: Allow machine to discard, watchlist, nurture, request verification or buy an approved deepening.
data_flows.storage_location_logical: API response, optional customer output log
data_flows.retention_draft: Output metadata retained for ledger/audit; full output retention optional and to be approved.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Delete full output where possible; retain ledger minimum for dispute/audit.
data_flows.live_blocker: valid output definition per product and ledger retention approval

data_flows.trigger: A valid output consumes a credit.
data_flows.purpose: Usage traceability, no-credit/refund handling and abuse prevention.
data_flows.legal_basis_to_confirm: contract and legitimate interest/security where applicable
data_flows.retention_draft: Longer than raw input because needed for disputes and accounting; duration to be approved.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Pseudonymize where possible after account closure; keep only required accounting/security records.

data_flows.trigger: Customer or account owner asks support, privacy or legal question.
data_flows.machine_actor: Support agent, ticket classifier, escalation workflow
data_flows.purpose: Support, privacy rights handling and legal escalation.
data_flows.legal_basis_to_confirm: contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest depending on request
data_flows.retention_draft: Support retention to be approved; privacy request register retained as legally required.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Delete non-required attachments and close ticket; retain minimal audit trail.

data_flows.trigger: System detects high volume, invalid keys, rate limit or suspicious usage.
data_flows.machine_actor: Rate limiter, cost guard, alerting agent
input_data_categories: IP or network metadata if collected
data_flows.purpose: Security, abuse prevention and cost control.
data_flows.storage_location_logical: security logs and cost guard event store
data_flows.retention_draft: Short security retention unless incident requires longer; suggested 30-90 days, to be approved.
data_flows.deletion_draft: Aggregate or delete after retention window.
data_flows.live_blocker: security log retention and incident response approval

subprocessor_inventory_draft.current_use: Workers, routing, possible logs/KV depending on deployment

retention_matrix_draft.suggested_retention: legal/defense period to be defined by professional

deletion_process_draft: Receive deletion/privacy request through approved channel.
Identify account owner and affected data category without exposing additional data.
Check whether MachineSignal is controller or processor for that flow.
If processor, route to customer/controller instructions.
Pseudonymize ledger/security records where deletion is not possible due to audit/legal need.
Record deletion outcome in privacy request register.
Escalate legal/privacy uncertainty to owner or professional reviewer.
open_owner_decisions: Approve whether real company/domain lists can be accepted.
Approve whether any personal business contact data is ever allowed.
Approve role split: controller, processor, subprocessor per flow.
Approve privacy notice and DPA final text.
Approve security log collection and IP retention.
Approve whether public-source discovery is permitted and under which rules.

readiness_after_data_map.reason: La mappa dati chiarisce flussi e rischi, ma retention, ruoli privacy, DPA, subprocessor e accettazione termini restano non approvati.
